Ritu Kapoor Astrology — social-media identity (2021).

A celestial Instagram system for an astrologer: deep royal blue, gold hand-script and a star-and-zodiac vocabulary. A zodiac wheel anchors the profile, and a repeatable post template carries weekly 'messages' for each sign — recognisable in a feed at a glance.

Social-media design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·72.
